summary: cmux 0.65.2 (113), commit 12023d89f, exposes no proven exclusive terminal input ownership/lease sufficient for NativeSubmitGuard. Live capabilities include terminal.input.exactly_once.v1, but same-version source scopes it to stream/sequence deduplication and permits untagged input. surface.input_state only reads screen/lifecycle; blocks_typing=false can accompany state=unknown. Participant disconnect/size ownership also supplies no held input lease. Preserved UNIMPLEMENTED and documented evidence; no advisory guard was added.
limitations: Version-scoped source/API investigation, not proof about future releases or byte-for-byte installed binary verification. No actual ownership race/input/model test was run. No user test surface operation, terminal input, service, MQ, dependency or task table added. No default enablement or guard implementation. Main ACK/review pending.
transport: cmux agent message via hooks. Installed agent-handoff wrapper points to a missing script; existing fallback types into terminals, forbidden by this task.
next: Main agent ACK and review pinned-source evidence, retain real TUI guard UNIMPLEMENTED and reject replacing ownership with blocks_typing=false, snapshot polling, local mutex/file lock or input-stream exactly-once. Reassess only if an enforcing native primitive becomes available.
